exposure: perceived autonomy in decision making during childbirth
subjective perception of childbirth as traumatic
outcome: perception of childbirth as a traumatic event
cohort: The study included 437 female respondents with an average age of 30.5 years, surveyed in four hospitals in Slovakia.
finding: Respondents who perceived a higher level of autonomy in decision making during childbirth reported higher overall satisfaction with childbirth.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery and type of delivery were significantly associated with birth satisfaction.
